applicability: Fisher r-to-z confidence interval checking whether a claimed metric-to-MOS correlation is statistically distinguishable from zero at the declared sample size
assumptions: the paired metric/MOS observations are independent and identically distributed
the underlying relationship is approximately linear
uncertainty: Standard textbook inferential statistics (Fisher 1921); hand-verified before use (r=0.85,n=30 -> CI approx (0.706,0.927); r=0.3,n=10 -> CI approx (-0.406,0.782)).
limits_policy: A confidence interval that includes zero is flagged as statistically unsupported rather than accepted.
